notes: Retail pay-as-you-go pricing (USD) for Southeast Asia region
Key Vault software-protected key is the primary cost driver at ~$1/key/month
Storage Account cost scales with data volume ($0.02/GB/month hot tier)
Key Vault operations billed at $0.03/10K — each Storage read/write triggers a key operation
Managed Identity and RBAC assignments are free
For HSM-protected keys (RSA-HSM), cost increases to ~$1.25/key/month
Actual costs may differ with Enterprise Agreements or Savings Plans
